title: Chapter 584
paragraphs: Chapter 584
Episode 151. Situation Summary (4)
Tower of Story.
"There was a lab in the middle of the Empire..."

Exhausted, Octavia ground her teeth as she spoke. Her body was wrapped in a magic bandage as if she was still unable to get out of the aftermath of the war, and various maintenance devices were connected to her back.

Dark spots peeked through the bandages. She had experienced erosion of chaos and even hyper-regeneration due to the Marcin Stone, so for the time being, she had to rely on the maintenance device every day.
"The Royal Family, those cunning bastards had bigger guts than I thought. Isn't the Empire's capital where our mages used to wander daily?"
Kadun, sitting next to her, was also seething with anger.
Hedo calmly lit a cigarette.
He was keeping calm simply because he really had no other thoughts, but it didn't seem that way to Octavia and Kadun.
It seemed as if he was exerting superhuman patience and analyzing the situation coolly.
"It's disgusting, but it's fortunate that the Royal Family has a trump card. So please calm down, Lord Kadun. And the Ghost Captain."
At Hedo's words, Kadun and Octavia coughed awkwardly.
"... Lord Hedo is right. I've shown a shameful side."
"Yeah... Those bastards are cornered, so they'll shamelessly reach out to us again."
A major change has occurred in the world's situation after the Sword Emperor's Palace.
It's now an era when we can't definitively say that Zipfel stands alone at the top of the families.

Of course, they haven't completely lost their position as the number one family, but the world's great powers didn't know their exact damage situation. They could only guess it was beyond imagination.
Therefore, the two major families had to check each other's moves and reinforce their forces as soon as possible, by any means necessary.
Even Runcandel still has Chiron intact.

It's a fait accompli that he has entered the territory of the Five Kings of the Black Sea, but as Zipfel, they have to consider the possibility that he can return to the continent at any time, and they're also concerned about the existence of the prophet.
In that sense, Zipfel couldn't help but covet the mana chemical technology that the Royal Family possessed.

After all, the Royal Family can't conspire with Runcandel. Because of Jin, and even if Rosa ignores him and requests an alliance first, it would be an unattractive proposal for the Royal Family. Runcandel would not have any magic engineering technology.
Above all, the Royal Family has maintained a closer relationship with Zipfel than with Runcandel.
Although they seem to have been stabbed in the back by the Sword Emperor's Palace, they needed each other in their current situation.

"Exactly. Because of the 12th generation of Lunkandell, the attempt to cut off the tail of the Empire failed, so they have no choice but to rely on us. No matter what negotiations we have, we will be able to proceed on favorable terms. We should not be angry, but rather welcome this."
The Zipfel does not know the exact power of the mine. The news from Jin's media that they have the power of regeneration beyond the 9-star knight was likely to be an exaggeration.
Nevertheless, they thought there must be a reason why the Empire dared to cling to them while deceiving them. They could examine the combat power sample directly during negotiations.
"Punishment can be postponed until after we extract their technology and our family recovers."
"But one strange thing is, how did the 12th generation of Lunkandell know the location of the research institute? It's impossible for our family to have less intelligence than him."
At Hedo's words, Octavia nodded.

"In my opinion, it's because a survivor of Hister is with the 12th generation. From the moment the 12th generation broke the grand magic of the family head in the war, it's almost confirmed that he and the record magician are together."
The 2nd type of the Annihilation Flame Pearl Demon Emperor, at the Black Emperor War, Jin showed as if he already knew that magic and easily broke it.
Octavia's gaze reached another maintenance device behind her.
There, Veradin Zipfel, who had tried to run rampant, was sealed. Since the Black Emperor War began, he has not regained consciousness even once.
Moreover, not only Octavia and Veradin were receiving help from the maintenance device.
Kelliark was in the maintenance device on the top floor of the Tower of Stories.
In other words, Zipfel was facing the worst times in a thousand years.
"Kelliark finally declared that he would find a survivor of Hister himself, but the Black Dragon Misha and the survivor of Hister are damn lucky."
"We should wait for contact from the Empire first. And when that child wakes up... we should have him meet the 12th generation of Lunkandell."
"Octavia, even if the 12th generation of Lunkandell is very close to Veradin. He surely won't spill any information about Hister, will he?"
"There's no harm in trying, Lord Kadun. Anyway, the 12th generation will also be curious about Veradin's condition, so he won't avoid the meeting."
As the conversation went that way, Hedo felt somewhat awkward. Before attending this meeting, he had received a favor from Sandra Zipfel.
-Auntie will definitely let Veradin meet Jin when he wakes up. Tell her I will go with him.
-It's not possible, miss.
-Yes.
-Every time you meet the 12th generation, you're essentially committing treason. The family head has been turning a blind eye so far, but if it continues.

-Ah! I have an idea. You said the record magician is with us, right? Then, Auntie can't send Veradin in a manipulated state, and that's why she'll be a little uneasy. Because she doesn't know what Veradin will say! I'll take on the role of watching him.
-"In my opinion, Miss's mouth could be a bigger problem."
-"Just deliver the message as is. End of conversation."
Whoo......
With a deep sigh accompanied by smoke from his cigarette, Hedo eventually let it go.
"Ghost General, what about sending Miss Sandra along with Prince Veradin?"
If anyone else had suggested this, Octavia would have deemed it unworthy of consideration.
"Why do you think so, Sir Hedo?"

"I think we need to keep an eye on Prince Veradin. Due to this recent rampage attempt, we can't quickly discern what memories he regained or lost. There's also a possibility that the survivor of Hister can verify if Prince Veradin's mind has been tampered with."
"You have a point. But if it's such a task, instead of a ticking time bomb like Sandra, a more reliable person should be...."
"If we send a properly qualified person, it would be difficult to avoid the suspicion of the 12th generation of Runcandel. The scope of the conversation between the two will naturally narrow."
Although Hedo felt something was lacking in his reasoning, he thought it was better than dealing with Sandra's potential tantrums later.
However, Octavia and Kadun surprisingly accepted his suggestion readily.

"Let's go with your suggestion. There's a peculiar energy between Sandra and the 12th generation of Runcandel, right? That might be helpful. Even if there's no record magician, the 12th generation has a contractor of Az Mil. Identifying mental manipulation is not a problem."

The peculiar energy was nothing but Sandra's unilateral love offensive, and Hedo wanted to reply that there was no way the 12th generation would lose their cool to such a thing, but he just stayed quiet.
"Understood, Sir Hedo. As soon as Veradin wakes up, let Sandra know to prepare as well."
He would have felt more at ease if they had refused.
Hedo could only respond with an awkward smile and a nod.
Of course, Talaris never expected his 77th lover from 30 years ago to still live in a log cabin in the remote area of the Phelin Kingdom.
He had given the mote, simply hoping his daughter and son-in-law would have a real date for once.
A young couple, a remote foreign land, perhaps still existing old log cabin. The conditions could hardly be better for love to flourish.
Boing-!
When the pure white dimensional gate opened, the scene was indeed romantic, just as Talaris had expected.
A dense forest, with no sunlight penetrating, formed a hemispherical space with bent trees, and in the middle of it was a picturesque, charmingly aged log house.
"It really is a remote area. I can't believe there really is a log house as Talaris said."
"Huh, Mort. You're not without responsibility for mother's persistence. If it weren't for your teleportation ability, mother's number of lovers would have been halved."
[Boo, Boong......]
"Anyway, there doesn't seem to be any noticeable damage here, so we should be able to take a quick look and leave."
"Yes, Sir Syris."
Contrary to Talaris's expectation, the two immediately started examining the situation, just like people who had come to work.
'If I knew I could get clues about Quaul Ganesto so easily, I would have asked Valeria to accompany me only up to here.'
If there was a record magic, there would have been no need to scour every corner of this wilderness; they could have simply looked at the records Quaul left here.
If no other information was discovered, it seemed better to come back again with Valeria later.
However, as soon as they entered the log house, the two were able to find traces of human habitation.
There was a faint smell of food, as if someone had eaten a few hours ago, along with a strong smell of cigarettes.
The floor was so full of cigarette butts and empty liquor bottles that there was hardly any room to step.
"......Is someone living here? It can't be that Quaul Ganesto, can it?"
"It would be nice if it was Quaul Ganesto, but it would be worrisome if things went too smoothly."
"He could have been, or perhaps still is, an engineer of the Zipfel, so there's no way he would be living in a place like this. Without any guards."
"Still, let's wait and see who it is."
"Mort, you go around and check the surroundings. Move stealthily......"
Syris, who was talking to Mort through the window, suddenly stopped talking. He saw a figure walking in the distance, behind Mort.

At first glance, the man had a scruffy beard and unkempt hair, looking like a typical bandit, and as soon as Syris saw him, he gave up the expectation that he could be Quaul. There was no hint of his mother's taste in any part of his appearance.
However, the next moment, the man shouted at the two of them and pulled something out of his pocket.
'......A mini magic cannon?'
Creak, chirp-!
The magic cannon that he pulled out initially looked small, but its parts moved and it transformed into a size larger than medium in an instant.
"Who are you guys?"
